rungs.title: Move to a pose
rungs.description: Moves both joints to a pose at 1.5 rad/s with the boards' full torque until Reached (1 degree), then holds 0.5 s. Tests that a step finishes on its done-when.

gates.why: every step finished on its done-when
within a degree of the pose when Reached fired
no board fault and no controller abort
the host kept its rate: no period went by without a command
a command goes out within one host period (10 ms) of the sample it came from

rungs.title: Seek a hard stop
rungs.description: Holds the shoulder and drives the elbow toward its hard stop at 0.5 rad/s under 3 N·m until Stall, then defines that position. Tests a homing step that ends on a contact.

gates.why: the stall was detected and the position defined
no board fault and no controller abort
the host kept its rate: no period went by without a command
a command goes out within one host period (10 ms) of the sample it came from

rungs.title: Host stall mid-move
rungs.description: S1 with a 0.5 s host stall at t = 0.3 s, mid-move; the boards' watchdog brakes. Tests that the sequence still finishes without running away.

gates.why: every step finished despite the stall
nothing went non-finite or out of bounds
